arxiv-2302-02605.title: Toward Large Kernel Models
arxiv-2302-02605.creator: Amirhesam Abedsoltan, Mikhail Belkin, Parthe Pandit
arxiv-2302-02605.description: Abstract Recent studies indicate that kernel machines can often perform similarly or better than deep neural networks (DNNs) on small datasets. The interest in kernel machines has been additionally bolstered by the discovery of their equivalence to wide neural networks in certain regimes.

arxiv-2307-09036.title: PromptMagician: Interactive Prompt Engineering for Text-to-Image Creation
arxiv-2307-09036.creator: Yingchaojie Feng, Xingbo Wang, Kam Kwai Wong, Sijia Wang, Yuhong Lu, Minfeng Zhu, Baicheng Wang, and Wei Chen
arxiv-2307-09036.description: Abstract Generative text-to-image models have gained great popularity among the public for their powerful capability to generate high-quality images based on natural language prompts. However, developing effective prompts for desired images can be challenging due to the complexity and ambiguity of natural language.

arxiv-2309-04136.title: Shape-morphing dynamics of soft compliant membranes for drag and turbulence modulation
arxiv-2309-04136.creator: Varghese Mathai, Asimanshu Das, Dante L. Naylor, Kenneth S. Breuer
arxiv-2309-04136.description: Abstract We study the kinematics and dynamics of a highly compliant membrane disk placed head-on in a uniform flow. With increasing flow velocity, the membrane deforms nonlinearly into increasingly parachute-like shapes. These aerodynamically elongated materials exhibit a modified drag law, which is linked to the elastohydrodynamic interactions.

arxiv-2502-09633.title: Bernoulli Partitions
arxiv-2502-09633.creator: Thomas Curtright
arxiv-2502-09633.description: Abstract Scale invariant scattering suggests that all Bernoulli numbers B 2 ​ n B_{2n} can be naturally partitioned, i.e., written as particular finite sums of same-signed, monotonic, rational numbers. Some properties of these rational numbers are discussed here, especially in the limit of large n n .

arxiv-2504-01464.title: A Prefixed Patch Time Series Transformer for Two-Point Boundary Value Problems in Three-Body Problems
arxiv-2504-01464.creator: Akira Hatakeyama, Shota Ito, Toshihiko Yanase, and Naoya Ozaki
arxiv-2504-01464.description: Abstract Two-point boundary value problems for cislunar trajectories present significant challenges in circler restricted three body problem, making traditional analytical methods like Lambert’s problem inapplicable. This study proposes a novel approach using a prefixed patch time series Transformer model that automates the solution of two-point boundary value problems from lunar flyby to arbitrary terminal conditions.

arxiv-2511-04616.title: NONPARAMETRIC SAFETY STOCK DIMENSIONING: A DATA-DRIVEN APPROACH FOR SUPPLY CHAINS OF HARDWARE OEMS
arxiv-2511-04616.creator: Elvis Agbenyega, Cody Quick
arxiv-2511-04616.description: Abstract Resilient supply chains are critical, especially for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) that power today’s digital economy. Safety Stock dimensioning—the computation of the appropriate safety stock quantity—is one of several mechanisms to ensure supply chain resiliency, as it protects the supply chain against demand and supply uncertainties.

europmc-pmc1937008.description: Background Breastfeeding behaviour is multifactorial, and a wide range of socio-cultural and physiological variables impact on a woman's decision and ability to breastfeed successfully. An association has been reported between maternal obesity and low breastfeeding rates. This i

pmc-10530123.title: Preparation, Structural Characterization, and Stability of Low-Molecular-Weight Collagen Peptides–Calcium Chelate Derived from Tuna Bones
pmc-10530123.creator: Yaqi Zhong, Yufang Zhou, Mingzhu Ma, Yadong Zhao, Xingwei Xiang, Conghan Shu, Bin Zheng, Pascal Degraeve
pmc-10530123.description: This study was conducted to prepare calcium chelate of low-molecular-weight tuna bone collagen peptides (TBCPLMW) with a high chelation rate and to identify its structural characteristics and stability. The optimum conditions for calcium chelation of TBCPLMW (TBCPLMW-Ca) were determined through single-factor experiments and response surface methodology, and the calcium-chelating capacity reached over 90% under the optimal conditions.

pmc-10694564.title: Case report of pulmonary brucellosis complicated by pleural effusion
pmc-10694564.creator: Shuaa Y. Mandili, Anas A. Albishi, Omaima ibrahim Badr
pmc-10694564.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Brucellosis is a bacterial disease and one of the most widespread zoonoses transmitted by an animal. It can affect any organ system, but pulmonary involvement is an unusual presentation according to the literature. We report the case of a 32 -year-old lady from Saudi Arabia who suffered from persistent fever and was found to have lobar pneumonia complicated by parapneumonic effusion. She started empirical antibiotics, and many investigations were done.

pmc-11391842.title: Predictive value of remnant cholesterol for left ventricular hypertrophy and prognosis in hypertensive patients with heart failure: a prospective study
pmc-11391842.creator: Zeyu Wang, Zhaoxin Zhu, Jianying Shen, Yan Zhang, Ting Wang, Yawei Xu, Dongyang Jiang, Weijing Liu
pmc-11391842.description: Background and AimRemnant cholesterol (RC) is substantially related to negative outcomes in cardiac patients. Patients with coexisting hypertension and heart failure (HF) often develop left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH) and have poor prognoses. This study investigated baseline RC levels and LV remodelling and patients’ prognoses.

pmc-12400363.title: MicroRNA (miRNA) in Plasma Small Extracellular Vesicles (sEV) as Potential Early Indicators of Dairy Cow Subfertility
pmc-12400363.creator: Pevindu Abeysinghe, Natalie Turner, Holly Flay, Susanne Meier, Leila Cuttle, Murray D. Mitchell
pmc-12400363.description: Pregnancy and live birth rates are commonly used metrics to define fertility in humans and animals. The impact of aberrant microRNA (miRNA) expression on fertility‐related genes represents a significant knowledge gap in understanding post‐transcriptional regulatory mechanisms associated with reproductive dysfunction.

pmc-12457738.title: PACO: a Shiny app for comparing perturbed pathways associated with different phenotypes
pmc-12457738.creator: Giovanni Micale, Salvatore Alaimo, Alfredo Pulvirenti
pmc-12457738.description: MotivationPathways are biological networks describing interactions between genes, proteins, non-coding RNAs, drugs and chemical compounds that contribute to develop a specific metabolic function or biological process. Identifying perturbed pathways associated with a phenotype or condition helps to understand how functional processes are altered in complex diseases and which genes play a key role in these alterations.

pmc-12743653.title: Functional group tolerant iron-catalyzed cyclotrimerization of terminal and internal alkynes
pmc-12743653.creator: Benedict Klinnert, Bernd Plietker
pmc-12743653.description: Arenes play a crucial role in various fields of chemistry. Since Kekulé proposed the molecular structure of benzene in 1865, chemists have been working to develop methods for preparing functionalized arenes. Most of these methods focus on introducing functional groups through substitution reactions (electrophilic aromatic substitution, cross-coupling, C-H activation) using aromatic starting materials.

pmc-13270608.title: Correction: Management of patients with protein s deficiency: focus on clinical course and direct oral anticoagulants
pmc-13270608.creator: Nicola Altamura, Filippo Giorgio Di Girolamo, Paola Pradella, Martina Cavalet, Federica Pellicori, Pierandrea Vinci, Emiliano Panizon, Giovanni Cominotto, Michele Zaccari, Irma Galasso, Paola La Rocca, Kaja Teraž, Massimo La Raja, Nicola Fiotti, Gianni Biolo

pmc-13458569.title: Environmental hazards and the risk of development of idiopathic urethral strictures
pmc-13458569.creator: Charles H Schlaepfer, Joemy M Ramsay, Jeremy B Myers, Michael B Christensen, James M Hotaling, Tarah Woodle, Lola P Lozano, Bradley A Erickson, Jane T Kurtzman
pmc-13458569.description: BackgroundThough idiopathic urethral strictures are a common form of strictures, little is understood about the pathophysiology leading to their development. This retrospective cohort study sought to analyze the risk of environmental toxins on the development of stricture disease.MethodsUsing the Utah Population Database (UPDB), we identified patients with idiopathic urethral strictures born between 1996–2021.

pmc-13465635.title: Dairy Spoilage Bacteria and Their Lipases: Prevalence Patterns and Molecular Traits
pmc-13465635.creator: Yuying Lu, Qian Wu, Jinling Wang, Pradeep K. Malakar, Xu Wang, Dongmei Wang
pmc-13465635.description: Dairy product spoilage is primarily caused by microbial contamination and lipase activity. Systematically assessing contamination risks and elucidating the structural and functional characteristics of key lipases form a crucial foundation for achieving precise prevention and control. This article integrated 79 studies (2003–2025) to preliminarily explore the geographical distribution characteristics of spoilage bacterial contamination.

pmc-13562457.title: Daratumumab monotherapy for relapsed AL amyloidosis: a single center retrospective analysis
pmc-13562457.creator: Jun Ho Yi, Sang Eun Yoon, Seok Jin Kim, Darae Kim, Jin-oh Choi, Ju-Hong Min, Byoung Joon Kim, Jung-Sun Kim, Jung Eun Lee, Junseok Jeon, Joon Young Choi, Kihyun Kim
pmc-13562457.description: PurposeTreatment of relapsed AL amyloidosis remains challenging as patients frequently suffer from severe organ dysfunctions. Daratumumab, a cornerstone drug in multiple myeloma and newly diagnosed AL amyloidosis, has also shown promise in relapsed AL amyloidosis.Materials and methodsTo assess the efficacy of daratumumab, we conducted a retrospective study of 40 patients who received daratumumab monotherapy in our prospective amyloidosis cohort.
